import json
import os

path = os.path.expanduser("~/.local/share/ji-host/data/host-identity.json")
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as source:
    value = json.load(source)
print("format=" + str(value.get("format")))
print("hostIdentityAlgorithm=" + str(value.get("hostIdentityAlgorithm")))
print("keys=" + ",".join(sorted(value.keys())))
print("deviceCount=" + str(len(value.get("devices", []))))
